name: HOPE: Winter Tale
source:
New Year...

It's a strange time. Some look forward to this day every year, while others have only darkness in their eyes. They don't care anymore.

Why wait for a holiday if there is no magic, some kind of fairy tale? So our main character has such a situation. For August, every New Year passes the same way – emptiness, darkness and uninteresting company.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413590/]Steam[/url]]
